native_client: Cursor desktop Windows x64 3.29.15; record actual version if it updates
setup: Synthetic workspace created before native queries. Four neutral rules: always, Python files, TypeScript files, root-only TypeScript glob. ACS predictions are frozen before native queries. Fresh chat per case; explicitly attach the listed files and record UI resolution. No rule/body/file change while collecting.
observations: Collect client-reported beforeSubmitPrompt and beforeReadFile attachment metadata, plus UI observations when available. Retain original event timing and the actual surface. Do not interpret model self-report or obedience as loading ground truth. Absent rule entries in a hook are unknown unless that hook's completeness for automatic rules is independently established. Keep disagreements and failures.
privacy: Only synthetic workspace contents may be sent for the probe. Hook logs retain allowlisted in-workspace attachment paths, event names, timestamps and hashed session identifiers. Prompts, file contents, email, credentials and external paths are omitted. No personal repository or account artifact is published.
limits: This is a versioned local smoke check, not platform-wide compatibility or an independent accuracy study. Account limitations, missing hooks or insufficient visibility remain unresolved. No subscription purchase or security-setting change is authorized by this experiment.
